title: Remove the default email recipient while creating a question alert
steps: Open the saved question's 'Move, trash, and more...' menu.
Choose 'Create an alert' to open the New alert modal with its default email recipient.
Remove the sole default email recipient, then view the empty email-recipient field and the modal actions.

video_guide.summary: Removing the default recipient immediately disables Send now until a recipient is provided.

chapters.note: New alert contains Bobby Tables and Send now is enabled.
The recipient field is empty and Send now changes to its grey disabled state.
Send now remains disabled with no recipients selected.
